statement: A genuine WASI component compiled from plain JavaScript by ComponentizeJS against the draft call-cell WIT world (typed list<row> batch of record/variant columns, emit and call-bounded imports returning result<_, deny-code>, run and reduce exports) is transpiled by @bytecodealliance/jco-transpile and instantiated in a deterministic test using the same toolchain path as the Cell runtime worker: typed batch rows round-trip exactly through run, emitted partials are captured by the host, an over-budget emit is refused with the typed budget-exhausted deny code and the guest observes the refusal, and reduce folds the published partials into the final ordered result — proving the native-call-context contract ABI is implementable with today's toolchain before any kernel work begins.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
